headline: Two teams left standing
caption:
Six contenders started the playoffs on Sept. 27. Two are still alive, and our model now has the Milwaukee Brewers at 67% to win the World Series.

Milwaukee is the biggest riser, up 41 points from 26% (peaking at 69%). Tampa Bay climbed from 10% to 33%, and 22 of those points came today alone, jumping from 11%.

The biggest fall belongs to the Los Angeles Dodgers: 24% at the start, as high as 37%, now out. Cleveland peaked at 20%, the Yankees at 17% and the White Sox at 9% before their runs ended.

Brewers at 67%, Rays at 33%. Does Tampa Bay have one more climb in it?
